item.title: Florida judge orders release of transcripts from abandoned Epstein grand jury investigation
item.description: A federal judge in Florida on Friday ordered the release of grand jury transcripts from the federal sex trafficking cases of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: 14 sickened in Legionnaires' disease outbreak linked to central Florida gym: reports
item.description: Over a dozen people contracted Legionnaires' disease in an outbreak linked to a gym in central Florida, officials confirmed to local media outlets this week.

item.title: Flags to be flown at half-staff across Florida Saturday, Sunday
item.description: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis has directed that the flags of the United States and the State of Florida be flown at half-staff at local and state buildings on Saturday in honor of Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day.

item.title: Man forces his way into Florida hotel room, tries to sexually batter employee: police
item.description: A man is facing multiple charges after police said he tried to sexually batter an employee at a Cocoa Beach hotel.

item.title: $280M Bee Ridge wastewater expansion to boost Sarasota County water quality
item.description: A major upgrade to Sarasota County’s wastewater system is underway at the Bee Ridge Water Reclamation Facility, marking a significant step in long-term efforts to improve local water quality.
